text:
### Duplicate Charge  
```
Exception: Customer charged twice for £500 transfer
Investigation: Two identical transactions within 1 minute (system duplicate prevention failed)
Resolution: Refund second charge + interest + £50 goodwill compensation
SLA: 3 business days (refund within 10)
```
name: Chunk 21/25

raw_entities.name: Duplicate Charge Exception Handling Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for investigating and resolving duplicate transaction charges on customer accounts. Covers identification of duplicate transactions, root cause analysis of system failures, and customer compensation including refunds, interest, and goodwill payments.
context: Exception: Customer charged twice for £500 transfer
Investigation: Two identical transactions within 1 minute (system duplicate prevention failed)
Resolution: Refund second charge + interest + £50 goodwill compensation
SLA: 3 business days (refund within 10)

raw_entities.name: Duplicate Transaction Investigation
raw_entities.description: Analysis step to identify and confirm duplicate transactions, including verification of transaction timing, amounts, and system failure root cause. In this case, two identical transactions occurred within 1 minute due to system duplicate prevention failure.
context: Investigation: Two identical transactions within 1 minute (system duplicate prevention failed)

raw_entities.name: Duplicate Charge Refund and Compensation
raw_entities.description: Resolution step executing customer compensation for the duplicate charge, including refund of the second charge, accrued interest, and goodwill compensation payment.
context: Resolution: Refund second charge + interest + £50 goodwill compensation

raw_entities.name: Duplicate £500 Transfer Transaction
raw_entities.description: Two identical £500 transfer transactions charged to the customer within 1 minute, resulting from a system duplicate prevention failure. The second charge was identified as erroneous and subject to refund.
context: Customer charged twice for £500 transfer
Two identical transactions within 1 minute (system duplicate prevention failed)

raw_entities.name: Duplicate Charge Refund Transaction
raw_entities.description: Refund transaction issued to customer comprising the second £500 charge, accrued interest, and £50 goodwill compensation, processed within the 10-day refund SLA.
context: Resolution: Refund second charge + interest + £50 goodwill compensation
SLA: 3 business days (refund within 10)

raw_entities.name: Duplicate Charge Affected Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer who was incorrectly charged twice for a £500 transfer due to system failure and received compensation including refund, interest, and goodwill payment.
context: Customer charged twice for £500 transfer
Resolution: Refund second charge + interest + £50 goodwill compensation
